description: Unit tests for QuicConnectionId class in the QUIC protocol implementation, testing creation, comparison, hashing, and length modification of connection IDs.

classes.name: QuicConnectionIdTest
classes.description: Test fixture class for QUIC connection ID tests.

methods.name: Empty
methods.description: Tests that an empty connection ID is recognized as empty.

methods.name: DefaultIsEmpty
methods.description: Tests that default-constructed connection ID is empty.

methods.name: NotEmpty
methods.description: Tests that a non-zero connection ID is not empty.

methods.name: ZeroIsNotEmpty
methods.description: Tests that a connection ID with value zero is not considered empty.

methods.name: Data
methods.description: Tests data access, equality, and length setting of connection IDs.

methods.name: SpanData
methods.description: Tests construction of connection IDs from byte spans and their lengths.

methods.name: DoubleConvert
methods.description: Tests conversion between connection ID and uint64.

methods.name: Hash
methods.description: Tests hash function for connection IDs, including zero IDs of different lengths.

methods.name: AssignAndCopy
methods.description: Tests assignment and copying of connection IDs.

methods.name: ChangeLength
methods.description: Tests resizing of connection IDs and data consistency after length changes.
